COMPLETE: analysis.py implemented from scratch (NumPy/SciPy only; no banned packages imported — verified by scan) and all ten artifacts written under results/.

== WHAT WAS BUILT ==
Discrete latent Markov model (K "rows"): matrix_a = K×K row-stochastic latent transition matrix, matrix_b = K×32 categorical emissions, vector_a = stationary distribution of matrix_a (initial prior pi0 kept internal, as approved). Fitting: hand-written log-space forward–backward + Baum–Welch EM with small pseudocounts for normalization safety; 8 independent restarts per K (1 segment-based init via windowed histogram k-means2 + 7 seeded random Dirichlet inits; all seeds fixed => deterministic). Candidates: HMM at K∈{2,3,4,5,6,8,10,12,16} plus an order-free mixture baseline at K∈{2,3,4,5,6,8}. Selection rule (documented in code): among candidates whose smallest row still carries ≥1% of posterior mass and whose rows are pairwise distinct (emission TV ≥ 0.05), pick the lowest BIC, then cross-check marginal gains, assignment uncertainty, held-out prediction, and row-level symbol/ordering differences.

== KEY BUG CAUGHT AND FIXED (quality gate) ==
Initial runs were invalid: (a) a NumPy fancy-indexing bug (`gam_sum[:, obs] += ...` with repeated symbol indices undercounts duplicates) silently broke the emission M-step — HMM fits scored BELOW the i.i.d. multinomial baseline, which is impossible for a nested family; (b) posteriors were passed as log-probabilities into diagnostics/local_weights; (c) held-out score underflowed to -inf. After fixes I validated the EM on synthetic data generated from a known K=3 HMM: recovered LL -38856 ≥ i.i.d. -38916, at the true-model optimum. All reported results come from the corrected code.

== CANDIDATE COMPARISON (objective = total log-likelihood, nats; criterion = BIC = -2LL + n_free·ln N; lower BIC better) ==
hmm_k2 -36564.8 / 73740 | hmm_k3 -35833.4 / 72615 (+731) | hmm_k4 -35367.6 / 72040 (+466) | hmm_k5 -35042.7 / 71766 (+325) | hmm_k6 -34994.9 / 72064 (+48) | hmm_k8 -34892.4 / 72704 (+103) | hmm_k10 -34749.9 / 73339 (+143) | hmm_k12 -34809.9 / 74454 (-60) | hmm_k16 -34684.7 / 76419 (+125)
Mixture baseline (order-free): mix_k2..mix_k8 all ≈ -37684.8 (the i.i.d. multinomial level; components collapse) — every HMM beats it by 1120–3000 nats, so the order-dependent claim is supported, not assumed.

== CHOSEN: K = 5 (hmm_k5) — justified by multiple signals ==
1. BIC minimum: 71765.7 at K=5 (next best K=4 at 72040, K=6 at 72064).
2. Marginal fit gains collapse after K=5: +731, +466, +325 per added row through K=5, then only +48 (K=6), +103 (K=8) — clear elbow.
3. Nontrivial row usage: stationary weights 0.368/0.187/0.154/0.152/0.140; min row posterior mass 0.172 (no row near death even at K=16, but extra rows buy almost no fit).
4. Assignment uncertainty rises with K and is low at K=5: mean posterior weight-entropy 0.387 nats (max ln 5 = 1.609), fraction of positions with max posterior <0.8 is 0.278, vs 0.513/0.394 at K=6 and 1.038/0.752 at K=16.
5. Rows are genuinely distinct: min pairwise emission TV 0.633 and min pairwise next-symbol-ordering TV 0.552 (per-row P(next symbol | row) = A·B). Row top-symbols differ clearly (row 0: 04/13/09/31; row 1: 12/11/03/01; row 2: 14/06/07/15; row 3: 08/10/15/16; row 4: 15/09/31/18).
6. Held-out one-step prediction (refit on first 80% of each stream, scored on last 20% in log space): best exactly at K=5 (-599.26/pos vs -602.7 at K=4, -605.5 at K=6, -609.6 at K=16) — note this disagrees with in-sample LL alone (which keeps creeping up to K=16), which is why no single score was used.

== FITTED STRUCTURE (K=5, canonical labels 0..4 by descending stationary weight) ==
matrix_a is strongly sticky (diagonal 0.80–0.95; mean sojourns ≈ 19/8/5/9/11 positions), matching the slow regime drift seen in inspection (first-vs-second-half TV 0.10–0.15). vector_a = [0.3681, 0.1866, 0.1540, 0.1516, 0.1396]. All 5 labels used across positions (counts 3046/2468/2074/2288/2059). Per-stream mean objective -2.86 to -2.99 nats/position; weight-entropy 0.33–0.42; dominant-label fraction 0.22–0.35 (defined as the fraction of a stream's positions carrying that stream's modal label).

== NORMALIZATION / REPRODUCIBILITY / CONSISTENCY DIAGNOSTICS ==
Asserted in-code before writing: matrix_a and matrix_b rows each sum to 1 (verified 1.000000), vector_a sums to 1 (0.9999999999999998), all values finite. local_weights.npy is (11935, 5), rows sum to 1 within 5e-13, rows exactly in data/sequences.csv global_index order (verified against the file), columns in the same canonical label order as matrix_a/matrix_b/vector_a rows. fit_trace.csv covers only K=5, runs 0–7 (independent restarts, fixed seeds), with per-step objective and relative_change (final values 2.7e-5–9.8e-5). Determinism re-check: an independent rerun of the 8 K=5 restarts reproduced identical restart ordering and the chosen restart's LL to 0.08 nats (the small offset is the one extra EM update applied after the trace's last recorded step, before posteriors are emitted). diagnostics.png is a valid 1560×1000 PNG (9 panels: LL by candidate, BIC vs K, marginal gains, row usage, uncertainty vs K, held-out vs K, matrix_a heatmap, row-distinctness vs K, summary text).

== LIMITATIONS / NOTES ==
- EM is still prone to local optima at large K (K=12 in-sample LL dips below K=10 despite 8 restarts); this is reported honestly in the table and does not affect the K=5 choice, which is robust across all six signals.
- diagnostics.png is rendered by a hand-written pure-Python/NumPy PNG writer (bitmap font, no anti-aliasing) because matplotlib is not installed and pip cannot reach an index in this environment.
- neighbor_summary uses the approved semantics (weight = A[row,col]; joint_fraction = stationary(row)·A[row,col]; conditional_value = A[row,col]); stream_diagnostics.dominant_label_fraction = fraction of positions carrying the stream's modal label; mean_objective = per-position log-likelihood of that stream.
- data/sequences.csv contains one extra column beyond the four named in the task (symbol_label, a string mirror of symbol); it is used directly as matrix_b's symbol_label.
- results/_fit_context.npz is an auxiliary file beyond the ten required artifacts (harmless; all ten required files verified present and nonempty).
